recent_fun: Tag that friend who says "Bas 5 km hai, 10 minute mein pahunch jaunga" and then reaches after 1 hour 40 minutes.
Bali mein traffic mein koi honk nahi karta. Delhi mein signal pe hari batti ka intezaar bhi nahi hota, peeche se orchestra shuru ho jaata hai.
Udta Teer: "Cleaner release window chahiye." Mera dost: "Bhai aaj ka plan cancel, kal dekhte hain." Dono ko Drishyam 3 se clash hai.
Dost Dubai shift hua: "Yahan luxury normal hai, bro."  Wahi dost jo kal tak chai ke 20 rupaye ka UPI split karta tha.
G7 Zoom call mein camera off ho gaya, internet bola nap ya bad hair day. Hum students 3 saal se yahi bahana de rahe hain: "Sir, camera kharab hai."
Naye shehar mein 1.5 saal baad chhoti cheezein pasand aane lagi hain: A) Thandi hawa B) Traffic mein mila free 'me time' Tum kya choose karoge?
Ek baar report time pe bhej di. Ab boss: "Tum toh fast ho, ye 3 aur le lo." Your best becomes your baseline. Ab main jaanbujhkar 'working on it' bolta hoon.
Expectation: Job lagegi toh Mercedes aayegi. Reality: Saturday dopahar ki 2 ghante ki neend hi ab asli luxury hai.
Gen Z cousin: "Bhaiya, har mahine enough money bhej dena." Main: "Enough kitna hota hai?" Cousin: "Jitna aapko lage ki aap mana nahi kar sakte."
Ghar pe bachha: 10 baar bolo tab ek chamach khayega. Railway pantry ka oats: pura bowl saaf. Mummy ka mood: Beta, ab ticket permanent kara lete hain.
Manager ki purani Santro pe hanste the. Aaj pata chala: Uski gaadi loan-free hai, hamari 'status' 48 EMI mein hai.
Papa ne Drishyam 3 dekhi. Ab fridge se mithai gayab hone par: "Beta, 7 baje hum sab saath mein movie dekh rahe the. Yaad rakhna." Mummy: "Papa, ye alibi nahi chalega."
Producer: "Series hit hui, itne calls aaye!"  Mere phone ke calls: Mummy: "Khana khaya?" Bank: "Personal loan chahiye?" Padosi: "Wi-Fi password kya hai?"
Mon-Sat: 5 alarms bhi nahi uthate. Sunday subah 6 baje: body khud uth gayi. Dimaag: Bhai, aaj toh chhutti hai. Body: Pata hai, bas tujhe dikhana tha.
Family group mein poll: Front-load ya top-load? Papa: Jo sasta ho. Bua: Front-load, paani bachta hai. Mummy: Kuch mat lo, main haath se dho lungi. Poll band.
AR Rahman Bengaluru traffic mein phans gaye. Oscar hai, Grammy hai, par 2 km ka signal nahi jeet paye. Jai Ho nahi, Jam Ho.
Oscar jeet liya, Grammy jeet liya. Bengaluru traffic bola: Sab theek hai, bas Silk Board se 'Jai Ho' bolke nikal ke dikha.
Notice period ka mood: Kaam kisi ne diya nahi. Reels ne kaha, 'Aaja bhai.' Laptop pe Excel khula hai, aankhon mein 400 reels.
Papa: Beta, notice period mein office mein kya karte ho? Main: Kaam dhoondh raha hoon. Mummy: Reels mein? Main: Haan, wahi toh knowledge hai. Bua: Salary toh aayegi na? Main: Bas wahi pakka hai.
Mummy ne beta ko samajhne ke liye gaming seekhi. Mummy: Ab samjhi, 'bas ek match' matlab 3 ghante. Beta: Mummy, aap toh pro nikli. Mummy: Khana thanda ho raha hai, pause kar.
Salary: 2006 mein atki hui hai. Rent: 2046 mein reh raha hai. Main: 2026 mein baith ke dono ke beech time travel kar raha hoon.
Bhagyashree ki mehendi saal bhar nahi utri, toothpick se khud laga leti thi. Meri salary: 1 tareekh ko aayi, 3 tareekh ko fade. Koi toothpick se salary bhi touch-up kar do.
Bhagyashree: Mehendi fade hui toh toothpick se khud laga di. Meri mehendi: Bartan dhote hi 2 din mein bola, "Bhai, main chali."
Guest list 2,000 se seedha ghar pe simple shaadi. Tum kya choose karoge? A) Mausi: "Humein toh bulaya hi nahi" B) Papa: "Khana bach gaya, bill bhi"
Bhutan mein road rage nahi hota. Hamare college canteen mein samosa ki line mein ho jaata hai.  Shaanti: 11:59 Break khatam: 12:00 Samosa khatam: 12:01
Foreigner ne IIT degree ka mazaak udaya. Internet: Bhai, tu rehne de. Mummy: IIT chhodo, pehle ye batao, Sharma ji ke bete ke 98% ke aage tumhara result kahan hai?
Tag that relative jo bolta hai: 'Mere padosi ka beta bhi IIT mein tha.' Ek American ne IIT ko chheda, poora internet Sharma ji ka beta ban gaya.
Dadu ki awaaz Delhi Metro mein aayi. Pota: Dadu, aap announcement kar rahe ho! Mummy ghar pe: Mujhe toh 20 saal se "Agla station: Khana ready hai" sunti hoon, koi taali nahi bajata.
Nayi car bolne se pehle mann padh legi. Mera mann: Biryani. Papa wali car: Budget dekh ke ghar chalte hain, dal chawal. Papa: Yehi toh asli AI hai.
Beta ne Claude ko mummy ki 24x7 video call pe baitha diya. Mummy: Khana khaya? Claude: Ji, 3 baar. Mummy: Jhooth. Shakal se bhookha lag raha hai.
Tag that dost jo San Francisco se mummy ko 24x7 video call pe rakhta hai. Mummy 3 baje uthi: Khana khaya? Claude: Haan. Mummy: Tujhse nahi puchha.
Dishwasher: Main kuch bhi saaf kar dunga. Festive kadhai: Pehle meri parat toh dekh. Mummy: Pehle haath se dho, phir machine mein daal. Machine: Toh main kya karun? Mummy: Sukhao.
8 mahine ghar baithe bande ne kaha: "Ghar pe zyada stress hai." Sach hai. Office mein boss ek hai. Ghar pe Mummy, Papa, Bua aur padosi, sabka same sawal: "Ab aage kya plan hai?"
Banda ne 25 LPA job chhodi. Pehla mahina: Flipkart ₹0, Amazon ₹45,000. Boss: Humne bhi kabhi ₹0 nahi diya. HR: Wapas aaja, notice period maaf.
Mummy: Soja beta, kal subah jaldi uthna hai. Main: Okay. Mummy khud 1 baje tak: Dekho ye reel, kitni mast hai.
Tag that friend jiska phone 1% pe hai, par 'bas ek reel' dekh ke charger se 2 kamre door baitha hai.
Me: Aaj pakka jaldi so jaunga. Padosi ne raat 11 baje drill machine chalayi. Me: Ab neend nahi, ab toh bas bhakti hai.
POV: Behen ne bola, 'Tere liye bhi maggi bana rahi hoon.' Main: Wah, pyaar. Behen: Bas bartan tu dhoyega.
Expectation: Amazon sale mein fridge aur TV sasta le lunga. Reality: 2 ghante baad cart mein phone cover, ₹49 ka charger aur ek peeler.
POV: Fridge mein kuch nahi hai. Mummy: Dekh, andar hi hoga. Main: Mummy, 4 baar dekha. Mummy: Dhyaan se dekha?
POV: Shower mein shampoo laga hai. Tabhi paani aana band. Mummy bahar se: "Bucket mein hai, use kar lo!"
Tag that friend jo lift mein padosi ko dekh ke phone nikaal leta hai, jabki phone mein network hi nahi hai.

items.brief: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 starts for everyone on October 8 (today), after early access for Prime members. Big festive-season discounts are expected on soundbars, AirPods and 55-inch LG and Samsung TVs. Gen Z shoppers will be hunting for gadget deals.

recent_thoughts: Monday ka matlab naya mauka hai. Bade sapne ek chhote kadam se shuru hote hain, aur wo kadam aaj hi uthana hai.
Monday ki shuruaat chhoti ho sakti hai, par uski niyat badi rakho. Aaj ka ek sahi kadam, kal ki badi manzil banata hai.
Discipline wo pul hai jo goal aur result ke beech hota hai. Mood roz badlega, par aadat tumhe roz aage badhayegi.
Girna haar nahi hai. Haar tab hoti hai jab tum uthne se pehle hi soch lete ho ki ab kya fayda.
